thread:
rachel: Quick thread 1: thinking about adding tool-call breadcrumbs into the run history row. Idea: a compact inline trail like [funcA > fetch_user > parse] that you can expand to see full invocation details. Keeps context without opening the drawer.

diego: Nice. Two UX concerns: 1) what happens when functions change signatures between runs? 2) screen reader behavior for the breadcrumb.

anika: For signature changes we could show a small yellow badge: "schema changed" with a tooltip saying which args differ. Also a link to view the diff.

tom: Breadcrumb expansion should be keyboard-accessible. Maybe allow right arrow to expand and left to collapse when focus is on the crumb.

rachel: Agree on keyboard nav. Also want a faster copy action next to breadcrumb: "Copy calls" to copy a minimal sequence for repro.

diego: Accessibility note: the breadcrumb should be a list (<ol>) with aria-label="Tool call sequence" and each item as button so screen readers announce them.

anika: Microcopy: instead of "schema changed" use "signature mismatch (run vs current)" 1 clearer. And tooltip: "One or more function parameter names or types are different from the current schema."

tom: Small UI nit: when collapsed the breadcrumb should show at most 3 calls then "..." to avoid very long rows. Also compact hover preview showing timestamps for each call.

rachel: Good point. Also propose a tiny inline delta icon if the schema diff is only in types vs names, and a full diff icon if structural. Signals severity.

diego: For the diff viewer modal, add a short textual summary at top for screen readers like: "2 parameter name changes, 1 type change" then the color-coded diff. Use aria-live when the modal opens.

anika: Copy language for the diff modal CTA: "Export run schema (JSON)" and secondary "Open current schema". Keep verbs explicit.

tom: Regarding run history perf: avoid computing diffs for every row eagerly. Lazy compute when user expands or hovers. Flag it in design doc.

rachel: Good. We'll annotate with a perf note. Also suggestion: allow filtering runs by "schema mismatch" so engineers can triage regressions.

diego: +1. That could be a useful saved filter. UX: show a tiny badge count in the header when mismatches > 0.

ux-bot: design-bot: Branch `breadcrumb-schema-diff` created and preview link posted to the PR. CI triggered.

anika: Accessibility follow-up: ensure the "Copy calls" action is exposed via context menu (right-click) and has a role=menuitem so keyboard users can access it.

tom: I prototyped arrow key behavior and pasted a gif in the PR showing right/left expand/collapse and space to open diff. Will attach contrast numbers too.

rachel: Thanks all. Next steps: Diego, write the aria snippets & saved filter spec. Anika, finalize copy for badges and tooltips. Tom, add the perf caveat to the PR. I'll update Figma with collapsed breadcrumb and mismatch badges.

diego: Will do, aiming for a draft by EOD.

anika: Copy ready, posting to PR now.

ux-bot: deploy-bot: Preview deployed at https://preview.redwood-inference/ui/breadcrumb-schema-diff :rocket:
